input.sql:
WITH wks AS (SELECT DISTINCT WK_END_DT FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY QUALIFY DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY WK_END_DT DESC) <= 13),
base AS (
 SELECT r.WK_END_DT, r.CHNL_CD, p.BRAND_NM, r.TRX_QTY
 FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r
 JOIN wks w ON w.WK_END_DT = r.WK_END_DT
 JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m ON m.PROD_NDC11 = r.PROD_NDC11 AND m.MKT_DEF='DRY_EYE' AND r.WK_END_DT BETWEEN m.EFF_FROM AND m.EFF_TO
 JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p ON p.PROD_NDC11 = r.PROD_NDC11)
SELECT CHNL_CD,
 SUM(CASE WHEN BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' THEN TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END) lac_trx, SUM(TRX_QTY) mkt_trx,
 ROUND(100*SUM(CASE WHEN BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' THEN TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END)/SUM(TRX_QTY),2) shr_13w,
 ROUND(100*SUM(CASE WHEN BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' AND WK_END_DT <= (SELECT MIN(WK_END_DT)+28 FROM wks) THEN TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN WK_END_DT <= (SELECT MIN(WK_END_DT)+28 FROM wks) THEN TRX_QTY END),0),2) shr_first5w,

text:
Over the last 13 weeks (weeks ending 3 Jul to 25 Sep 2026), Lacrivia had **23.8% of dry-eye prescriptions (TRx)**: 10,442 of 43,975. Its share is rising overall, from 22.8% in the first 4 weeks to 24.6% in the last 4. That gain comes almost entirely from Commercial, while Medicare Part D is falling clearly.

| Payer channel | Lacrivia TRx | Market TRx | 13-wk share | First 4 wks | Last 4 wks | Trend |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial | 5,649 | 21,530 | **26.2%** | 23.6% | 28.8% | ▲ +5.2 pts: steady climb, with a jump in the week of 14 Aug; about 29% for the last 3 weeks |
| Cash / Discount | 585 | 2,414 | **24.2%** | 22.1% | 25.3% | ▲ +3.2 pts, but erratic: peaked at 31.7% on 4 Sep, back to 21.4% in the latest week |
| Medicaid FFS | 436 | 1,885 | **23.1%** | 20.4% | 24.4% | ▲ +4.0 pts, but only about 35 Lacrivia TRx a week, so treat with caution |
| Managed Medicaid | 999 | 4,412 | **22.6%** | 22.4% | 21.6% | ▼ −0.9 pts: peaked at about 25% in early Aug and has drifted down since |
| Health Exchange | 589 | 2,679 | **22.0%** | 21.7% | 22.5% | ► Flat; weekly share swings between 15% and 26% |
| Medicare Part D | 2,184 | 11,055 | **19.8%** | 22.2% | 18.3% | ▼ −4.0 pts: the only real decline |
| **All channels** | 10,442 | 43,975 | **23.8%** | 22.8% | 24.6% | ▲ +1.8 pts |

**What stands out**
- **Commercial is driving the growth.** The market there is flat at about 1,650 TRx a week, while Lacrivia went from about 390 to about 490 TRx a week. That is real share gain, not a bigger market.
- **Medicare Part D is the concern.** Lacrivia's weekly TRx fell by about 10%, while the Part D dry-eye market grew by about 10% (about 800 to about 920 TRx a week). It is losing share in a growing market. The drop starts the same week as the Commercial jump (14 Aug).
- I didn't check formulary or claims data. A Part D coverage change, for example a tier change or new prior-authorization rules, is a guess worth checking with the paid-rate metric on the claims table.

- "Last 13 weeks" means the 13 most recent weeks in the data.
- The trend compares the first 4 weeks with the last 4, rather than single weeks, to smooth out weekly swings.

base AS (
 SELECT r.WK_END_DT, r.CHNL_CD, p.BRAND_NM, r.TRX_QTY
 FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r
 JOIN wks w ON w.WK_END_DT = r.WK_END_DT
 JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m ON m.PROD_NDC11 = r.PROD_NDC11 AND m.MKT_DEF='DRY_EYE' AND r.WK_END_DT BETWEEN m.EFF_FROM AND m.EFF_TO
 JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p ON p.PROD_NDC11 = r.PROD_NDC11)
SELECT CHNL_CD,
 SUM(CASE WHEN BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' THEN TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END) lac_trx, SUM(TRX_QTY) mkt_trx,
 ROUND(100*SUM(CASE WHEN BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' THEN TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END)/SUM(TRX_QTY),2) shr_13w,
 ROUND(100*SUM(CASE WHEN BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' AND WK_END_DT <= (SELECT MIN(WK_END_DT)+28 FROM wks) THEN TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN WK_END_DT <= (SELECT MIN(WK_END_DT)+28 FROM wks) THEN TRX_QTY END),0),2) shr_first5w,
 ROUND(100*SUM(CASE WHEN BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' AND WK_END_DT > (SELECT MAX(WK_END_DT)-28 FROM wks) THEN TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN WK_END_DT > (SELECT MAX(WK_END_DT)-28 FROM wks) THEN TRX_QTY END),0),2) shr_last4w,
 (SELECT MIN(WK_END_DT) FROM wks) first_wk, (SELECT MAX(WK_END_DT) FROM wks) last_wk
FROM base GROUP BY CHNL_CD
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ALL', SUM(CASE WHEN BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' THEN TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END), SUM(TRX_QTY),
 ROUND(100*SUM(CASE WHEN BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' THEN TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END)/SUM(TRX_QTY),2), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM base
ORDER BY 1

WITH wks AS (SELECT DISTINCT WK_END_DT FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY QUALIFY DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY WK_END_DT DESC) <= 13)
SELECT r.WK_END_DT, r.CHNL_CD,
 SUM(CASE WHEN p.BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' THEN r.TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END) lac_trx, SUM(r.TRX_QTY) mkt_trx,
 ROUND(100*SUM(CASE WHEN p.BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' THEN r.TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END)/SUM(r.TRX_QTY),1) shr
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r
JOIN wks w ON w.WK_END_DT = r.WK_END_DT
JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m ON m.PROD_NDC11 = r.PROD_NDC11 AND m.MKT_DEF='DRY_EYE' AND r.WK_END_DT BETWEEN m.EFF_FROM AND m.EFF_TO
JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p ON p.PROD_NDC11 = r.PROD_NDC11
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT CHNL_CD, MIN(WK_END_DT) mn, MAX(WK_END_DT) mx, COUNT(DISTINCT WK_END_DT) n, SUM(BRAND_TRX) lac, SUM(MKT_TRX) mkt, ROUND(100*SUM(BRAND_TRX)/SUM(MKT_TRX),2) shr
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.MART.PYR_SHR_WK
WHERE BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' AND WK_END_DT >= (SELECT DATEADD(week,-12,MAX(WK_END_DT)) FROM PHARMA_DEMO.MART.PYR_SHR_WK)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
